title: Infantino offers apology but 'no answers' at FIFA meeting over World Cup plan

blocks.text: FIFA president Gianni Infantino gave "no satisfactory answers" when grilled Thursday during a meeting to discuss his attempts to sell stakes in the World Cup to private investors, senior members of football's global governing body said, but he did offer an apology for the failed project.
